title: Rav Chana bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.62b.18) he speaks in the name of Rav Sama, son of Rav Mari. [Yevamot 78b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.78b.13) mentions him saying that David decreed against the Netinim. Yuchasin says he was Rav Yehudah’s student, but Hyman writes that he found no source for this. [Chullin 133a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.133a.10) mentions Mar Yochana as his son in Rava’s time in one version of the story.[^2]

notes.text: The failure to locate support for the Yuchasin student claim is Hyman’s statement, not a new claim that all sources have been searched.

The [Chullin passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.133a.10) gives two versions of the visit. Mar Yochana’s father is called Rav Chana bar Ada in one and Rav Chana bar Bizna in the other. The [Seder HaDorot entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1373&lang=en) repeats the studentship claim and records the transmission from Rav Sama.
